jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Hiring: Senior Oracle Fusion Contracts Management Functional Consultant

🔹 Experience:

  • 10+ yrs Oracle ERP, 5+ yrs Fusion Cloud

  • 3+ full‑cycle Fusion Enterprise Contracts implementations

  • Strong Supply Chain & Procurement background

🔹 Role: Lead design, implementation & optimization of Oracle Fusion Enterprise Contracts. Drive workshops, configuration, testing, training & post‑go‑live support. Ensure seamless integration with Procurement, Purchasing, Supplier Management & Supply Chain.

🔹 Key Skills:

  • Enterprise Contracts (Authoring, Terms, Clauses, Templates, Approvals, Deliverables, Lifecycle)

  • Procurement & Purchasing (POs, Requisitions, Supplier Mgmt, Sourcing)

  • Fusion Security, BPM, OTBI, BI Publisher, OIC, FBDI/ADFDI

  • Strong stakeholder management & consulting skills

🔹 Preferred: Oracle certifications, multinational project experience, leadership in large complex implementations.

Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant

Experience: 5+ Years
Location: Saudi Arabia (KSA) | Onsite

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant with strong expertise in Fusion development, integrations, and reporting.

Key Skills:

  • Oracle Fusion Technical Development
  • PL/SQL, BI Publisher & OTBI
  • FBDI / ADFDI
  • REST & SOAP APIs

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Arabic - Oracle Fusion HCM / Finance / SCM Consultant

Position: Oracle Fusion Cloud Consultant
Experience: 1–5 Years
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia 

Must be bilingual - Arabic and English 

Job Summary

We are looking for Oracle Fusion Cloud Consultants with 1–5 years of experience in Oracle Fusion HCM, Finance, or SCM. The candidate will be responsible for supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and business process requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, support, and enhancement projects.
  • Understand business requirements and provide appropriate Oracle Fusion solutions.
  • Perform functional configuration and application setups.
  • Prepare and execute SIT, UAT, and functional testing.
  • Analyze and resolve functional issues and production incidents.
  • Support data migration activities using FBDI/ADFDI/HDL, as applicable.
  • Coordinate with technical teams for integrations, reports, extensions, and data migration.
  • Prepare functional documents, test scripts, and user documentation.
  • Participate in client meetings, workshops, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
  • Provide post-go-live support and assist in continuous process improvements.

Required Skills

  • 1–5 years of Oracle Fusion Cloud experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in HCM, Finance, or SCM.
  • Good understanding of business processes and Oracle Fusion functionality.
  • Experience in configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.
  • Knowledge of OTBI / BI Publisher is an advantage.
  • Basic understanding of integrations such as REST/SOAP APIs is preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and client-handling skills.
